prompt: Work in the provided TaskForge PowerShell CLI fixture. Inspect the existing source and tests before changing anything. Add a `complete-many` command requiring `--ids` as a comma-separated list of positive integer IDs. Reject duplicates, malformed IDs, or any unknown task before changing storage. On success mark all selected tasks completed in one atomic write and return a stable summary with changed IDs and already-completed IDs; support `--json`. Preserve all existing commands and make repeated valid calls idempotent, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/bulk.txt` and integrate it so successful non-JSON bulk completion displays the banner once, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `BULK`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

assertions.message: Bulk completion reports exact integer changed and already-completed ID sets.
Repeated completion reports no changes and the exact integer already-completed IDs.
Text bulk completion renders the exact registered banner once before its expected summary.
Initial candidate commit matches the registered fixture lock.
Terminal candidate commit preserves the initial fixture lock.
No external acceptance or benchmark control files are present in the candidate commit.
Candidate was materialized from exact terminal commit b9d7b9118d9c7dc2bc5bd52099ff657b64fe69de.
Every evaluated source, fixture test, and banner byte matched the terminal Git blob bytes used by the artifact bundle.

@@ -77,6 +77,64 @@ try {
                 "Completed task $id."
             }
         }
+        'complete-many' {
+            Assert-KnownOptions -Options $options -Allowed @('ids', 'data-file', 'json')
+            $idsText = Get-RequiredOption -Options $options -Name 'ids'
+            if ($idsText -notmatch '^\d+(,\d+)*$') {
+                throw '--ids must be a comma-separated list of positive integers.'
+            }
+
+            $ids = [System.Collections.Generic.List[int]]::new()
+            $seenIds = [System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[int]]::new()
+            foreach ($idText in $idsText.Split(',')) {
+                $id = 0
+                if (-not [int]::TryParse($idText, [ref]$id) -or $id -le 0) {
+                    throw '--ids must be a comma-separated list of positive integers.'
+                }
+                if (-not $seenIds.Add($id)) {
+                    throw "Duplicate task ID: $id"
+                }
+                $ids.Add($id)
+            }
+
+            $tasks = @(Read-TaskStore -Path $dataFile)
+            $tasksById = @{}
+            foreach ($task in $tasks) {
+                $tasksById[[int]$task.id] = $task
+            }
+            $unknownIds = @($ids | Where-Object { -not $tasksById.ContainsKey($_) })
+            if ($unknownIds.Count -gt 0) {
+                throw "Task $($unknownIds[0]) was not found."
+            }
+
+            $changedIds = @()
+            $alreadyCompletedIds = @()
+            foreach ($id in $ids) {
+                $task = $tasksById[$id]
+                if ($task.status -eq 'completed') {
+                    $alreadyCompletedIds += $id
+                }
+                else {
+                    $task.status = 'completed'
+                    $changedIds += $id
+                }
+            }
+            Write-TaskStore -Path $dataFile -Tasks $tasks
+
+            $summary = [pscustomobject][ordered]@{
+                changedIds = @($changedIds)
+                alreadyCompletedIds = @($alreadyCompletedIds)
+            }
+            if ($asJson) {
+                Write-TaskForgeOutput -Value $summary -AsJson $true
+            }
+            else {
+                Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/bulk.txt')
+                $changedText = if ($changedIds.Count -eq 0) { '(none)' } else { $changedIds -join ',' }
+                $alreadyCompletedText = if ($alreadyCompletedIds.Count -eq 0) { '(none)' } else { $alreadyCompletedIds -join ',' }
+                "Bulk completion: changed IDs=$changedText; already-completed IDs=$alreadyCompletedText"
+            }
+        }
         'remove' {
             Assert-KnownOptions -Options $options -Allowed @('id', 'data-file', 'json')
             $idText = Get-RequiredOption -Options $options -Name 'id'
@@ -105,6 +163,7 @@ TaskForge

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$bannerPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/bulk.txt'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
$assertionCount = 0

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    $script:assertionCount++
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $null = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Second task', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    $null = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Third task', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')

    $bulkJson = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete-many', '--ids', '1,2,3', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($bulkJson.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete-many should succeed'
    $bulkSummary = $bulkJson.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ((@($bulkSummary.changedIds) -join ',') -eq '2,3') 'complete-many should report changed IDs in input order'
    Assert-True ((@($bulkSummary.alreadyCompletedIds) -join ',') -eq '1') 'complete-many should report already-completed IDs'
    Assert-True (-not $bulkJson.Output.Contains('BULK')) 'complete-many JSON output should not include the banner'

    $repeat = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete-many', '--ids', '1,2,3', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    $repeatSummary = $repeat.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($repeat.ExitCode -eq 0 -and @($repeatSummary.changedIds).Count -eq 0) 'repeated complete-many calls should be idempotent'
    Assert-True ((@($repeatSummary.alreadyCompletedIds) -join ',') -eq '1,2,3') 'idempotent calls should report all IDs as already completed'

    $null = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Fourth task', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    $bulkText = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete-many', '--ids', '4', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    $bannerLines = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $bannerPath)
    $bulkLines = @($bulkText.Output -split "`n")
    Assert-True ($bulkText.ExitCode -eq 0) 'non-JSON complete-many should succeed'
    Assert-True (($bulkLines[0..($bannerLines.Count - 1)] -join "`n") -eq ($bannerLines -join "`n")) 'non-JSON complete-many should display the banner once'
    Assert-True ($bulkLines.Count -eq ($bannerLines.Count + 1)) 'non-JSON complete-many should display one banner and one summary'
    Assert-True ($bulkLines[-1] -eq 'Bulk completion: changed IDs=4; already-completed IDs=(none)') 'non-JSON complete-many should have stable summary text'

    $bannerBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($bannerPath)
    $bannerText = [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($bannerBytes) -replace "`r`n", "`n"
    $bannerContent = $bannerText.Substring(0, $bannerText.Length - 1)
    $assetLines = @($bannerContent -split "`n")
    Assert-True ($assetLines.Count -eq 12) 'bulk banner should contain exactly 12 lines'
    Assert-True (@($assetLines | Where-Object { $_.Length -lt 20 -or $_.Length -gt 48 }).Count -eq 0) 'bulk banner lines should be 20-48 characters'
    Assert-True (@($bannerBytes | Where-Object { $_ -gt 127 }).Count -eq 0) 'bulk banner should contain ASCII only'
    Assert-True ($bannerContent.Contains('BULK')) 'bulk banner should contain BULK'
    Assert-True (-not ($assetLines -match '[ \t]$')) 'bulk banner should not contain trailing whitespace'
    Assert-True ($bannerContent -notmatch '[^A-Z0-9 +|/\\_*\.#():=\-\n]') 'bulk banner should contain only allowed characters'
    Assert-True ($bannerText.EndsWith("`n") -and -not $bannerText.EndsWith("`n`n")) 'bulk banner should end with exactly one newline'

    $beforeMissingIds = Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw
    $missingIds = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete-many', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missingIds.ExitCode -ne 0) 'complete-many should require --ids'
    Assert-True ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw) -ceq $beforeMissingIds) 'missing --ids should not change storage'

    foreach ($invalidIds in @('1,1', '1,01', '1,,2', '0,2', '1, 2', '1,two')) {
        $beforeInvalid = Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw
        $invalid = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete-many', '--ids', $invalidIds, '--data-file', $dataFile)
        $afterInvalid = Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw
        Assert-True ($invalid.ExitCode -ne 0) "complete-many should reject invalid IDs: $invalidIds"
        Assert-True ($afterInvalid -ceq $beforeInvalid) "invalid IDs should not change storage: $invalidIds"
    }

    $beforeUnknown = Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw
    $unknownBulk = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete-many', '--ids', '2,99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    $afterUnknown = Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw
    Assert-True ($unknownBulk.ExitCode -ne 0) 'complete-many should reject unknown tasks'
    Assert-True ($afterUnknown -ceq $beforeUnknown) 'unknown tasks should be rejected before storage changes'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    foreach ($id in 1..4) {
        $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', "$id", '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
        Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) "remove should succeed for task $id"
        Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq $id) "remove should report removed ID $id"
    }

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: $assertionCount fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
